notes: Internal checker integration metadata, not DGL column 16a codes. Entry.source_stowage_codes preserves the actual DGL SW/H codes. The adapter appends these explicit internal identifiers to entry.stowage_codes so checker 2.4 uses its existing verified_provisions fail-closed mechanism.

guards.meaning: UN2915 radioactive stowage and segregation remain unresolved: evaluate all applicable 7.1.4.5 conditions, including surface heat flux, transport-index and criticality-index accumulation, exclusive use, dose rates, contamination, and segregation from crew and passengers. Missing shipment/radiological facts fail closed. SW20/SW21 verification alone does not clear these conditions. A qualified external verifier must record this identifier in verified_provisions only after completing that evaluation.

columns: stowage conditions and segregation table for persons

other_fail_closed_entries.mechanism: Checker 2.4 rejects numeric class-1 stowage category 02. Its general-table '*' handling also refuses to clear explosive compatibility. No verified_provisions flag bypasses the category rejection.

unresolved.row: Hatchless holds and partially weathertight covers
